Account Executive, SaaS Platform — Northwind Software (London / remote-friendly)

Northwind builds a workflow automation platform used by operations teams at mid-market
companies. We are growing the commercial team and looking for an AE to own the full
sales cycle for new business in EMEA.

The role
- Run the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, technical demo, security review, pricing
  and close. Deal sizes typically £15k–£60k ARR.
- Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's stack, and translate
  technical capability into operational and commercial outcomes.
- Partner with solutions engineering on integration scoping, onboarding plans and
  proofs of concept.
- Manage pipeline hygiene in HubSpot, forecast accurately, and work multi-threaded
  deals across IT, operations and finance stakeholders.
- Feed customer requirements back to product to shape the roadmap.

You will thrive here if you have
- Experience selling software, SaaS or technical solutions to business buyers.
- The ability to run a credible technical conversation — integrations, CRM and systems
  implementation, data migration, user adoption.
- A structured approach to discovery, qualification and deal control in a high-velocity
  environment.
- Curiosity about product and a track record of onboarding customers successfully, not
  just closing them.
